label: (99942) Apophis
note: Fitted with the Yarkovsky effect (the 7th parameter). The real orbit is reshaped by its close approach to Earth on 13 April 2029, which a two-body model ignores.

label: 2024 YR4
note: Briefly a possible 2032 Earth impactor; further observations in 2025 ruled that out.

label: 2008 TC3
note: Observed for less than a day before it hit Earth on 7 October 2008, less than three hours after this epoch; this page ignores Earth, so its clones carry on.

label: 12P/Pons–Brooks
note: A comet, fitted with non-gravitational accelerations from outgassing (A1 and A2), which the two-body model here leaves out.

label: 3I/ATLAS
note: Interstellar, on a hyperbolic orbit (e > 1), so it has no Keplerian semi-major axis or period.
